about_the_game:
Axe Ghost is an unforgiving turn-based spatial battle against an advancing monster horde. You play cards to manipulate your enemies positions, grouping them up before destroying them in a bid to make your mark on the daily leaderboard.

Each run lasts around 20 minutes. The weapons dealt let you push, swap, clone, slice, freeze, magnetize and destroy the advancing monsters before they reach the bottom of the grid. Group them cleverly - the more monsters you destroy in a single attack, the more each one is worth. Accept optional constraints in the form of Quests to multiply your score. Spend Coins to play extra cards in critical moments.

Lord Garnemar, the loathsome boss, is only vulnerable when surrounded on four sides by the same type of monster. Defeat him before deadly robots overrun the battlefield and the timer runs out.

I hear them approaching.

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2017+)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Apple M1 or Intel Iris)

reviews:
“What I like most about Axe Ghost is how it takes some game things that feel quite ancient and primitive and turns them into a random conundrum generator, offering meaty, puzzly turns that sometimes had me stumped for good stretches.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“I was in brainburning heaven. When AXE GHOST clicks it's an Experience. You start seeing patterns, perfect pathways of using your mobility cards to shift the blocks of monsters just right for one grand slam, a deadly hit to see the buggers routed.”
Tiny Gaming
short_description: In Axe Ghost you cleverly push monsters around a grid and blow them up in turn-based spatial combat. Take on the Daily Challenge and face off against the loathsome Garnemar!
supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Traditional Chinese
